title: fix: agent updates keep fields that are left out
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- `PATCH /account/agents/:id` for prompt agents merges the request into the stored config, so `{"title": "x"}` or `{"systemPrompt": "..."}` alone works (was 400 "expected string, received undefined")
- `polli agents update <id>` no longer requires `--config`; help says to pass only the fields to change
- Tests: enter partial update keeps baseModel/mcpServers/systemPrompt; CLI body without config

gist.headline: Patch the patch
gist.blurb: Prompt agents can now keep their thoughts while you change one small detail. Send a new title or system prompt; the rest of the hive stays put.
gist.summary: Fixed `PATCH /account/agents/:id` for prompt agents to merge partial updates into the stored configuration, preserving omitted `baseModel`, `mcpServers`, and `systemPrompt`, while `polli agents update <id>` now accepts only the fields being changed without requiring `--config`.
gist.impact: Users can update an agent title or a single prompt field independently instead of supplying a complete config and encountering missing-field validation errors.
gist.visual_concept: A prompt-agent configuration is a cozy garden of labeled plants: title, base model, MCP servers, and system prompt. Polli carefully replants only one small title flower while the other established code-plants remain healthy and untouched; a nearby CRT robot can hold a tiny PATCH watering can or configuration clipboard to make the selective-update metaphor clear.
